plugins.name: vpn-core (sing-box)
plugins.summary: sing-box proxy manager with plugin-owned sandbox pages for Lines, VPN identities, per-node runtime profiles, and usage.

plugins.name: Sub-Store companion
plugins.summary: Sub-Store companion: imports vpn-core nodes into a managed Sub-Store subscription. The alpha channel is a self-contained signed bundle with its own sandboxed Extensions UI.

plugins.name: netguard (nftables security groups)
plugins.summary: nftables security-group firewall manager with plugin-owned Extensions UI backed by the core NetGuard compiler, linting, approval, dead-man watchdog, and node-agent apply pipeline.

plugins.name: wireguard (VPN networks)
plugins.summary: WireGuard networks manager with plugin-owned Extensions UI backed by the core topology compiler, safe key handling, approval, dead-man watchdog, and node-agent apply pipeline.
